params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date of a date range of payroll changes.  ISO 8601 date or RFC 3339 date time date (ex. 2017-12-01 or 2017-12-01T12:30:30-06:00).

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date of a date range of payroll changes.  ISO 8601 date or RFC 3339 date time (ex. 2017-12-01 or 2017-12-01T12:30:30-06:00).

params.name: is_custom_id
params.description: Set to true if the {id} in the path is customer generated.

params.name: current
params.description: Return only the subscriber's current coverage records.

params.name: previous
params.description: Return only the subscriber's coverage records that are immediately prior to the current record.
